about.bio1: I'm a Product Manager specialising in AI and Data Analytics, and a co-founder of <0>Pyre</0>, a Norwegian software company I run with two friends. Outside of that, I <1>write here</1> occasionally, built <2>Deafening Silence</2> as a free tool for tinnitus sound therapy, and keep a <3>shelf</3> of books I've enjoyed.
about.bio2: Travelling has also taught me valuable lessons such as how much people have in common, even on the other side of the globe. But mainly I travel for the food.
